description: List all bookmakers with name, active, createdAt, status (ok, degraded, down) and reason (maintenance, unavailable, or null). Use status/reason to explain why a bookmaker has no odds: a 'down' bookmaker is left out of odds, value bets and arbitrage until it recovers.

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

name: get_bookmakers
title: List bookmakers
